idea-plugin.name: EWP Project Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Keep *.ewp project files (from IAR EWARM) in sync with changes in CLion.

Features

  • Keep the ewp file in sync: When adding, deleting, or moving source files, the plugin updates the *.ewp project files accordingly.
  • Ensure correct order of files in ewp: In case you manually edit the file lists in a *.ewp, use the "Reformat" action to sort the file lists correctly, like EWARM does.
  • Edit the ewp file lists: The EWP Explorer panel allows to add/remove files, or move them to different groups by drag-and-drop.
  • Remove stale files: The plugin detects files that are no longer present on disk and offers a quick fix to remove them from the *.ewp.
  • Support for multiple ewp Files: The plugin detects all *.ewp files in the project tree.

What this plugin is not

This plugin can NOT load ewp files as a project to build them. You still need to load a project by the means supported in CLion (e.g. Cmake, compilation database)

Legal Notice

This is an unofficial plugin for .ewp files used with IAR Embedded Workbench for Arm (EWARM). This plugin is not affiliated with IAR Systems.
